lineup.name: The Crispy Cup
lineup.pitch: A milk chocolate peanut butter cup with crisped rice folded into the filling. One cup per wrapper, sweet, not hard.

lineup.name: Plain peanut butter cup
lineup.pitch: The same cup without the crisp. This recipe already exists and owns the top two spots.

lineup.name: Chocolate and fruit
lineup.pitch: Chocolate-covered chewy fruit. The simple model likes it, but only one real candy has tried the pair.

lineup.name: Everything bar
lineup.pitch: Chocolate, caramel, peanut, nougat and crisp in one bar. Every add-in that scored well, all at once.

lineup.name: Chewy fruit bites
lineup.pitch: Soft fruit chews, many per pack, never hard. The best fruit-only recipe in the data.
